verdict.rationale: Gazebo ships an official `gz` CLI: `gz sim shapes.sdf` launches simulations, with `-s` for headless server, `-g` for GUI-only, and `-v 4` for verbosity. The repo advertises "extensive command line tools for increased simulation introspection and control", Gazebo Fuel has its own command line tools, and a GUI-free server package targets headless/CI use. missing for 10: a documented full command reference beyond the getting-started flags, evidence of machine-readable/structured output or agent-oriented scripting guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use in automated/AI workflows.
